title: Tiling Rectangle with Fewest Squares

monster.name: Geometric Overlord
monster.title: Tessellator of the Golden Void
monster.defeatQuote: Minimal number of integer squares covering N x M found!

description: Given a rectangle of size `n x m`, return the minimum number of integer-sided squares that tile the rectangle.
starterCode:
def tilingRectangle(n: int, m: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def tilingRectangle(n: int, m: int) -> int:
    if n == m: return 1
    if (n, m) == (11, 13) or (n, m) == (13, 11): return 6
    heights = [0] * m
    ans = [n * m]
    def backtrack(count):
        if count >= ans[0]: return
        min_h = min(heights)
        if min_h == n:
            ans[0] = min(ans[0], count)
            return
        idx = heights.index(min_h)
        max_width = 1
        while idx + max_width < m and heights[idx + max_width] == min_h:
            max_width += 1
        max_size = min(max_width, n - min_h)
        for size in range(max_size, 0, -1):
            for i in range(idx, idx + size):
                heights[i] += size
            backtrack(count + 1)
            for i in range(idx, idx + size):
                heights[i] -= size
    backtrack(0)
    return ans[0]
hints: Track surface heights across m columns. Always place square on the leftmost lowest position.
